items.title: Out-of-Pocket Costs Rival Vomiting as Reason to Stop GLP-1s
items.summary: Claims data miss patients who pay cash. A new survey that included these patients found out-of-pocket costs higher than $50 a month predicted GLP-1 discontinuation better than vomiting. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Podiatrists and Dermatology Clinicians: Sharing Expertise
items.summary: Given differences in training and focus, podiatrists and dermatology clinicians should establish a relationship that permits them to consult, refer, or comanage cases, advised a podiatrist. Medscape Medical News

items.title: FDA Approves Durvalumab With Enfortumab Vedotin for MIBC
items.summary: With the approval, there's a rival to perioperative pembrolizumab with enfortumab vedotin for patients with cisplatin-ineligible muscle-invasive bladder cancer. Medscape Medical News

items.title: Off-Label Therapies for Several Skin Diseases Reviewed
items.summary: Evidence supporting off-label treatments of pyoderma gangrenosum, Sweet syndrome, and Grover disease is available. Medscape Medical News

items.title: US Measles Cases Rise to 5,412, CDC Says
items.summary: The US CDC on Friday reported 5,412 measles cases in the country ⁠as of November 12, up by 230 from the previous update, as the ⁠country battles its worst outbreak of the... Reuters Health Information

items.title: Microsoft Outage Disrupts NHS Email, but Care Goes On
items.summary: Patients are told to attend appointments as usual, but pharmacies report delays and a union warns of a 111 and 999 backlog. Press Association
